result.title: Supervised Hebbian Class Networks: Learning Without Backpropagation
result.summary: This paper introduces Supervised Hebbian Class Networks as a method for training multi- layer perceptrons and convolutional networks without gradient calculations or backpropa- gation. Each neuron in a learned layer is assigned a class, while connections follow the usual fully connected or convolutional pattern. The method combines a class-based supervision rule shared across layers with a Lion optimizer adapted to Hebbian activity products. All layers train together throughout the run, and their activities provide class predictions di- rectly, without a separately trained classifier. The experiments test the method on MNIST with a multilayer perceptron and on CIFAR-10 with a convolutional networ

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Supervised Hebbian Class Networks，为每个神经元指定类别并以类监督的 Hebbian 规则替代反向传播，在 MNIST 与 CIFAR-10 上验证多层感知机与卷积网络的训练。
AI.relevance_reason: 论文只针对静态图像分类的无梯度训练规则，不涉及视觉推理中的内部状态、证据使用或停止决策，与 LVR 主线的具体联系仅限于泛化的「免反向传播」训练思路，缺乏可核查的迁移线索。
